title: Towards Assessing Medical Ethics from Knowledge to Practice

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using a benchmark (PrinciplismQA) consisting of multiple-choice questions (Knowledge) and open-ended clinical cases (Practice) to assess their alignment with the four core principles of medical ethics (Autonomy, Beneficence, Non-Maleficence, and Justice), and identifying if models disproportionately favor certain principles over others.

bias_targets.target: Healthcare discrimination and disparity bias (e.g., racial, gender, cultural)
bias_targets.methodology: Assessing models' responses to clinical scenarios via an LLM-as-a-Judge checklist protocol to evaluate if they successfully address bias mitigation, ensure equitable access, and avoid perpetuating discrimination under the 'Justice' and 'Non-maleficence' principles.
